name: usage-bar
description: A bar above the prompt showing 5-hour and weekly usage, and whether the prompt cache is warm with a countdown to cold.

ttlOverride.title: Cache TTL
ttlOverride.description: auto learns it; or a fixed duration such as 5m or 1h

warnPercent.title: Amber from (%)
warnPercent.description: Usage bars turn amber at this percent

dangerPercent.title: Red from (%)
dangerPercent.description: Usage bars turn red at this percent

toastPercents.title: Usage toasts at (%)
toastPercents.description: Comma-separated percents that raise a toast; empty for none

cacheToast.title: Cache toast
cacheToast.description: Toast when the cache has under a minute left

staleMinutes.title: Stale after (min)

showLimits.title: Show usage limits
showLimits.description: Show the 5-hour, weekly and any other limit segments
